The text describes a setting characterized by horse-drawn carriages, gas lighting, and cobblestone streets, which are hallmarks of the 19th century. The architectural styles mentioned, Georgian and Victorian, further narrow the timeframe, with the Victorian era specifically spanning from 1837 to 1901. The reference to Charles Dickens as a contemporary figure whose works are the "talk of the town" confirms this period, as Dickens was most prominent during the mid-to-late Victorian era.

The part of a tree that grows underground is the **roots**.
